text: Ty is rooted at `.`; it includes `og.py` and `tests/**/*.py`, excludes `.venv/**`, `.outcomegraph/**`, and `**/__pycache__/**`, and sets `possibly-unresolved-reference`, `invalid-return-type`, and `unused-type-ignore-comment` to `error` while `invalid-argument-type`, `invalid-assignment`, `no-matching-overload`, `not-iterable`, `not-subscriptable`, `unresolved-attribute`, and `unsupported-operator` are `ignore`.
